purpose: Resolve the narrow correct-TB transition found between -10 dB and -8 dB and quantify natural receiver complementarity.

selection_source.confirm17: both paths 200/200 correct at -8 dB through +4 dB
selection_source.wide_smoke: both paths 0/10 correct at -10 dB and below

radio.channel: independent block-Rayleigh coefficient per RX antenna and complex AWGN

interpretation_limit: Fine-grid selection is based on the separately retained broad sweep and smoke results; it is a follow-up protocol rather than a replacement of those outcomes.
